# truenas_iscsi_targetextent (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS iSCSI target/extent association (LUN mapping) by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric iSCSI target/extent association ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `extent` (Number) ID of the iSCSI extent.
- `lunid` (Number) LUN ID for this association.
- `target` (Number) ID of the iSCSI target.
